workload: This revision only: one batch INSERT of 10000 rows (three fresh databases) and one batch INSERT of 100000 rows (one fresh database) into a rowid table, plus 200 single-row inserts. No pre-change binary was measured, so this file is not a before/after delta.
limitations: One Linux x64 AOT process. Each sample includes parsing and the image write. RSS is the whole process. 100000 single-row inserts were not run because each insert rewrites the tree. No earlier sample exists, so no speedup is claimed. This is not an M9 scale, platform, or native-SQLite comparison.
